system_cpu.scope: Timed commands only. Approximate command windows use log final-write mtime minus measured duration; logs are written immediately after completion. Two-second telemetry intervals and short-lived process exits limit attribution. Overlapping intervals are clipped to their chronological union. Same-UID versus other-UID CPU is process ownership, not user-mode versus kernel-mode time. This audit describes overlap and does not alter sample acceptance.

excluded_host_attempts.reason: Sustained outside CPU use dominated by the Falcon security service exceeded the predeclared load limit.
The original all-process CPU limit rejected sustained Falcon activity while system maintenance was also active.
